bullets.id: Emas stabil pada Jumat setelah anjlok sehari sebelumnya. Emas spot ditutup di sekitar $3.883, naik 0,18% menurut Kitco, dengan rentang harian $3.874–$3.924. PPI Oktober naik 0,3%, di bawah perkiraan 0,4%, tetapi inflasi produsen tahunan mencapai 6,5%, tertinggi sejak November 2022, sehingga pemantulan tetap terbatas dan emas mencatat kerugian mingguan yang tajam.
bullets.en: Gold stabilised on Friday after the previous day’s slump. Spot gold ended near $3,883, up 0.18% according to Kitco, with a daily range of $3,874–$3,924. October PPI rose 0.3%, below the 0.4% forecast, but annual producer inflation reached 6.5%, the highest since November 2022, so the bounce stayed limited and gold posted a steep weekly loss.

bullets.id: Yield Treasury 10 tahun naik ke arah 5,15% dan indeks dolar bertahan di atas 103. Pasar memberi peluang 89% untuk kenaikan 25 bps pada rapat Fed 8–9 Desember dan 11% untuk 50 bps. Minyak justru turun dua pekan beruntun, dengan Brent di $95,84. Emas kini turun sekitar 5,5% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 31% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: The 10-year Treasury yield rose toward 5.15% and the dollar index held above 103. Markets price an 89% chance of a 25 bp hike at the Fed’s 8–9 December meeting and 11% for 50 bp. Oil, by contrast, fell for a second straight week, with Brent at $95.84. Gold is now down about 5.5% on the month and about 31% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Support terdekat ada di titik terendah 13 bulan $3.852, lalu $3.823; RoboForex menilai penembusan di bawah $3.852 membuka jalan ke $3.777. Resistance berada di $3.903–$3.934, lalu $3.970. Pekan depan pasar menunggu penjualan ritel Oktober pada Selasa dan risalah rapat Fed pada Rabu 18 November.
bullets.en: The nearest support is the 13-month low at $3,852, then $3,823; RoboForex says a break below $3,852 opens the way to $3,777. Resistance sits at $3,903–$3,934, then $3,970. Next week markets await October retail sales on Tuesday and the Fed minutes on Wednesday, 18 November.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp8.000 ke Rp2.517.000 dan buyback naik Rp8.000 ke Rp2.293.000, sehingga spread tetap Rp224.000 (sekitar 8,9%). Galeri24 dicatat Rp2.462.000 (buyback Rp2.317.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS Rp2.485.000 (buyback Rp2.292.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Secara struktural, bank sentral membeli 321 ton pada kuartal III, naik 42% secara tahunan.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp8,000 to Rp2,517,000 and buyback rose Rp8,000 to Rp2,293,000, keeping the spread at Rp224,000 (about 8.9%). Galeri24 lists Rp2,462,000 (buyback Rp2,317,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS Rp2,485,000 (buyback Rp2,292,000, spread about 7.8%). Structurally, central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3, up 42% year on year.
